title: ASHROOT NURSERY — abandoned fungal sanctuary
status: design only; resource importer not admitted

coordinate_contract.ordering: terrain first, then ordered feature placements, last write wins
coordinate_contract.empty: unwritten cells do not erase host terrain; explicit id=0 does
coordinate_contract.orientation: authored orientation only; no approved rotation or mirroring
coordinate_contract.anchor: ground feature local bottom y=height; ceiling feature top y=0; not a structural proof
coordinate_contract.layers: no independent decoration layer; all rectangles are actual material writes

style_guide.theme: dark fungal observatory; lilac/green biological veins against black basalt and ochre layered earth
style_guide.organic: Fungus 18 / Plant 11 / MossWall 97 / OakLog 83 are reactive
style_guide.accent: QuartzCrystal 122 and PhosphorPanel 127; phosphor is not a lighting fixture
style_guide.ratio: approximately 60% empty air, 25% dark earth/rock, 10% biological pink/green, 5% pale jade
style_guide.rhythm: one tall fungal marker followed by low shelves and a mineral stela, 12-16 horizontal gap
style_guide.negative_space: do not fill intended air with background solids
style_guide.orientation: no rotation/mirroring without re-evaluating anchors/neighbor rules

features.title: Knot-root flying buttress
features.visual_effect: Arched root-chords framed by lilac mycelial tips
features.placement_rules: Join full width to real floor; preserve arch opening and 12-cell lateral gap
features.simulation_notes: Fungus/Plant grow; OakLog and MossWall remain combustible; no structural support proven.

features.title: Spore lantern tower
features.visual_effect: Triple-capped violet tower with pale jade bands
features.placement_rules: Bed to fixed ground, clear overhead >=8; keep 16 cells away from hot surfaces
features.simulation_notes: Fungus/Plant growth and ignition; OakLog/MossWall combustible. Phosphor is a fixed appearance, not a light source.

variants.note: Burned stem, retained reactive fungal canopy

features.title: Terraced mycelial shelves
features.visual_effect: Low layered steps carrying fungal brackets and dense plant tufts
features.placement_rules: Continuous bottom floor; leave at least 12 cells beside neighbour
features.simulation_notes: Plant/Fungus are stateful; MossWall is combustible. Changes to contour not yet tick-qualified.

features.title: Ceiling-thread veil
features.visual_effect: Unequal fungal strands hanging from slate and basalt lip
features.placement_rules: Ceiling lip must meet actual host roof; 60 empty cells under longest strand
features.simulation_notes: Fungus and Plant grow; no tensile or hanging constraint exists.

features.title: Seed-caldera cradle
features.visual_effect: Recessed amphitheatre with a held cluster of rose-coloured grains
features.placement_rules: Fixed bowl floor required before adding seeds; leave 8 cells air above rim
features.simulation_notes: Seed 19 is movable powder with germination/ignition kernel. No retention or growth profile tested.

features.title: Rootbound cistern
features.visual_effect: Black stone witness tank lined with translucent jade beneath a violet crown
features.placement_rules: Explicit host clearing + fixed sealed vessel required; no hot neighbour
features.simulation_notes: Water 3 is conserved FreeMass, not a static filled rectangle. Fugus can grow; leaking/pressure/uniform quantity untested.

features.title: Nursery threshold
features.visual_effect: Blackened forest ruin forming a large arch with living crown
features.placement_rules: Two grounded feet; don't assume traversable portal without actor clearance
features.simulation_notes: CharredTimber 90 and MossWall 97 remain combustible, Fungus 18 grows. Arch contour may change.

features.title: Mineral chorus stela
features.visual_effect: Fixed low-contrast mineral monument and phosphor geometry
features.placement_rules: One every 180–250 cells on continuous floor, do not count as a real lamp
features.simulation_notes: Only kernel None and immovable cells; optical appearance and collision remain unqualified.
